info.name: NFCI Backend API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the NFCI Backend Laravel application.

Base URL: http://localhost:8000/api/v1

## Authentication
This API uses JWT (Bearer Token) authentication. Start by registering or logging in to get a token. The token is automatically saved to the `token` collection variable.

## Workflow
1. Register or Login → token is auto-saved
2. Use any protected endpoint (token is applied via Bearer auth)
3. Refresh token before expiry
4. Logout when done

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints — register, login, logout, refresh, and profile.

request.description:
Register a new user account.

**Validation:**
- `name` — required, string, max 255
- `email` — required, valid email, unique
- `password` — required, min 8 chars, must match `password_confirmation`

**Note:** Token is auto-saved to collection variables on success.

Login with email and password to receive a JWT token.

**Validation:**
- `email` — required, valid email
- `password` — required

**Note:** Token is auto-saved to collection variables on success.

Get the authenticated user's profile.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

Refresh the current JWT token. Returns a new token and invalidates the old one.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Note:** New token is auto-saved to collection variables on success.

Logout and invalidate the current JWT token.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Note:** Token variable is cleared on success.

item.name: Public
item.description: Public endpoints that do not require authentication.

request.description:
Render a page by its page number for frontend consumption.

Returns the page with all **visible** components, their configs, and assets.
Only **active** pages are returned.

**No authentication required.**

**URL Params:**
- `pageNumber` — integer (the page to render)

query.description: Filter by status: active, draft, archived. Leave empty for all.

request.description:
List all pages with pagination.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Query Params:**
- `per_page` — optional, max 100 (default 15)
- `status` — optional, filter by: `active`, `draft`, `archived`

Get a single page by its page number, including all components and assets.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `pageNumber` — integer

body.raw:
{
    "page_number": 1,
    "title": "Home Page",
    "slug": "home",
    "meta_description": "Welcome to the NFCI home page",
    "status": "active",
    "components": ["CTA 1", "IMGGAL 2"]
}

request.description:
Create a new page, optionally attaching components by compound ID.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body:**
- `page_number` — required, integer, unique
- `title` — required, string, max 255
- `slug` — optional, string, unique
- `meta_description` — optional, string, max 1000
- `status` — optional, one of: `active`, `draft`, `archived`
- `components` — optional, array of compound IDs (e.g. `["CTA 2", "IMGGAL 3"]`)

Update page metadata.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `pageNumber` — integer

**Body (all optional):**
- `title` — string, max 255
- `slug` — string, unique
- `meta_description` — string, max 1000
- `status` — one of: `active`, `draft`, `archived`

Soft-delete a page by its page number.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `pageNumber` — integer

item.name: Page Components
item.description: Manage components attached to a page — attach, update, remove, and reorder.

request.description:
Attach one or more components to a page.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `pageNumber` — integer

**Body:**
- `components` — required, array (min 1)
  - `component_id` — required, string (compound ID like `"CTA 2"`)
  - `sort_order` — optional, integer (min 0)
  - `config_overrides` — optional, object
  - `is_visible` — optional, boolean

Update a specific page component's config, visibility, or sort order.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `pageNumber` — integer
- `pageComponentId` — integer (the `page_components.id`)

**Body (all optional):**
- `sort_order` — integer (min 0)
- `config_overrides` — object or null
- `is_visible` — boolean

Remove a component from a page.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `pageNumber` — integer
- `pageComponentId` — integer (the `page_components.id`)

Bulk reorder components on a page.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `pageNumber` — integer

**Body:**
- `order` — required, array (min 1)
  - `id` — required, integer (existing `page_components.id`)
  - `sort_order` — required, integer (min 0)

item.name: Component Types
item.description: Manage component types and their variants — full CRUD.

request.description:
List all component types with their variants.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

Get a single component type by its code, including all variants.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `code` — string (e.g. `HERO`, `CTA`, `IMGGAL`)

Register a new component type.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body:**
- `code` — required, string, max 50, unique (auto-uppercased)
- `name` — required, string, max 255
- `description` — optional, string
- `schema` — optional, object (defines the config schema)

Update an existing component type.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `code` — string (the component type code, e.g. `HERO`)

**Body (all optional):**
- `code` — string, max 50, unique (auto-uppercased)
- `name` — string, max 255
- `description` — string or null
- `schema` — object or null

Delete a component type and all its variants.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `code` — string (the component type code, e.g. `HERO`)

**Note:** Will return `409 Conflict` if any variants are currently attached to pages. Remove them from pages first.

Register a new variant for an existing component type.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `code` — string (the component type code, e.g. `HERO`)

**Body:**
- `variant_number` — required, integer, min 1
- `name` — required, string, max 255
- `description` — optional, string
- `default_config` — optional, object

Update an existing variant of a component type.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `code` — string (the component type code, e.g. `HERO`)
- `variantNumber` — integer (the variant number to update)

**Body (all optional):**
- `variant_number` — integer, min 1 (change the variant number)
- `name` — string, max 255
- `description` — string or null
- `default_config` — object or null

**Note:** If changing `variant_number`, will return `409 Conflict` if the new number already exists.

Delete a specific variant from a component type.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `code` — string (the component type code, e.g. `HERO`)
- `variantNumber` — integer (the variant number to delete)

**Note:** Will return `409 Conflict` if the variant is currently attached to any pages. Remove it from pages first.

item.name: Assets
item.description: Upload and manage assets (images, videos, documents) for page components.

formdata.description: ID of the page_component to attach assets to
Files to upload (max 20 files, each max 10MB). Allowed: jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, svg, mp4, webm, pdf, doc, docx
Alt text for each uploaded file (optional)
Type of asset: image, video, document, icon (default: image)

request.description:
Upload one or more assets to a page component.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body (multipart/form-data):**
- `page_component_id` — required, integer (existing page_components.id)
- `files[]` — required, array of files (1-20 files, each max 10MB)
- `alt_texts[]` — optional, alt text per file
- `asset_type` — optional: `image`, `video`, `document`, `icon` (default: `image`)

**Allowed file types:** jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, svg, mp4, webm, pdf, doc, docx

Delete an asset by its ID.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL Params:**
- `assetId` — integer
